title: Open Studio, refined
question: A larger chat invites the artist to give Relay a task. Current order has been removed; the gallery and monthly schedule retain their space. This is a design review sketch with sample content.

options.label: Open Studio · larger chat
options.thesis: One generous rounded chat box above the gallery, with the monthly schedule on the right.
options.viewport: The chat fills the upper workspace. A file + sits at its bottom-left corner; the searchable gallery remains below.
options.risk: A longer conversation will need a deliberate expansion behavior in a later iteration.
